summary: US forces enforced a naval blockade of Iranian ports by firing Hellfire missiles at a Panama-flagged vessel in the Gulf of Oman, while the IRGC threatened to target global infrastructure if Iran is threatened. Simultaneously, Houthi forces attacked a Saudi military equipment ship in Bab al-Mandab, and at least 15 Saudi tankers are diverted toward the Strait of Hormuz amid reports of Iranian fire near Sirik.
key_points: US Navy helicopter fired two Hellfire missiles at the engine room of M/V Vela Nova after its crew ignored warnings while attempting to breach the blockade of Iranian ports in the Gulf of Oman. (Source: @VahidOnline/77818)

At least 15 Saudi tankers unable to transit Bab al-Mandab are now approaching the Strait of Hormuz, raising questions whether they will pass or be targeted by the IRGC. (Source: @kianmeli1/90809)
Explosion heard near Sirik with reports indicating Iranian firing toward the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @kianmeli1/90814)
IDF Division 99 forces identified and engaged a Hamas sniper near the yellow line in northern Gaza, confirming a hit. (Source: @yediotnews25/133802)
IDF demolished the home of Farouk Ramadan in the West Bank village of Tell after he killed Maj. Yuval Ezra and Sgt. Benayahu Mellet on July 24. (Source: @manniefabian/58949)

Lebanon daily report recorded 175 alerts, 147 drone sightings, one drone strike in Nabatieh, one airstrike in Deir Siryan, and 20 artillery shelling incidents across multiple villages. (Source: @redlinkleb/35963)

sections.executive_summary: US forces kinetically enforced a naval blockade of Iranian ports by firing Hellfire missiles at a Panama-flagged container ship in the Gulf of Oman after its crew ignored warnings. The IRGC responded with explicit threats to target global energy infrastructure, power plants, and internet-connected systems worldwide if Iran faces further threats. Concurrently, Houthi forces struck a Saudi military supply vessel in Bab al-Mandab, while 15+ Saudi tankers diverted toward the Strait of Hormuz amid unconfirmed reports of Iranian fire near Sirik.

sections.threat_assessment: The kinetic enforcement of the US naval blockade on Iranian ports marks a significant escalation in maritime interdiction, with direct fire on a commercial vessel signaling reduced thresholds for force. The IRGC's explicit threat to target global critical infrastructure — energy grids, power plants, and internet systems — represents a deterrence posture extending far beyond regional boundaries. Concurrent Houthi strikes on Saudi shipping in Bab al-Mandab and the diversion of 15+ Saudi tankers toward Hormuz create a dual chokepoint crisis. The reported Iranian fire near Sirik, if confirmed, would indicate direct Iranian military activity at the strait. These developments suggest a coordinated pressure campaign across maritime domains with high risk of miscalculation.
sections.regional_response: Pakistan's defense minister claims Iran and the US are nearing an agreement, while Qatar reports advanced Iran-Oman talks on Hormuz shipping security — suggesting diplomatic off-ramps are being pursued alongside military escalation. Israel continues tactical operations in Gaza and the West Bank while integrating new ultra-Orthodox reserve units for northern deployment. Lebanon faces sustained artillery and drone pressure with high detection but low engagement rates. The Damascus court's death sentences for Assad leadership signal judicial consolidation by the new Syrian authorities. Regional actors appear to be hedging between diplomatic de-escalation channels and military readiness.
sections.intelligence_notes: The US expenditure of ~50 Patriot interceptors in a single day ($200M+) reveals high operational tempo and potential stockpile concerns reflected in the FY2027 budget request for 3,655 interceptors. CENTCOM's precise tracking of 55 vessel diversions, 3 disablings, and 2 boardings indicates robust maritime domain awareness. The IRGC's threat to target "internet-connected infrastructure globally" suggests cyber-physical convergence capabilities. The Houthi claim of striking a Saudi military vessel in Bab al-Mandab aligns with the tanker diversion pattern. Israeli civilian incursions into Syria at Hermon indicate persistent border discipline challenges. The Erbil fuel tanker fire appears accidental but occurs amid heightened regional tension.
